title: Can the right diet get rid of acne?
section: A low-glycemic diet may lead to fewer pimples
originalExcerpt: While these findings show that following a low-glycemic diet can lead to fewer breakouts, other studies have not found a connection between a high-glycemic diet and acne. More research is needed to know for sure.
text: AAD 介绍：低升糖负荷饮食与痤疮的研究结果并不一致。有些研究发现痤疮减少，另一些研究没有发现高升糖负荷饮食与痤疮的关联；仍需要更多研究才能确定，不能声称食谱可以治疗痤疮。

title: Triggers could be causing your rosacea flare-ups
section: Important to know what triggers your rosacea
originalExcerpt: Anything that causes your rosacea to flare is called a trigger. Sunlight and hairspray are common rosacea triggers. Other common triggers include heat, stress, alcohol, and spicy foods. Triggers differ from person to person.
text: AAD 说明：玫瑰痤疮的加重诱因因人而异。阳光、发胶、热、压力、酒精和辛辣食物属于常见诱因，并非每个人都会被同一种因素诱发。这里讨论的是已确诊玫瑰痤疮的诱因，不能仅凭泛红自行诊断。

title: 7 rosacea skin care tips dermatologists recommend
originalExcerpt: To reduce the likelihood of a product irritating your skin, choose fragrance-free (rather than unscented) products.
text: AAD 针对玫瑰痤疮易受刺激的皮肤建议：选择标注为 fragrance-free（无香料）的产品，以降低刺激可能；unscented（无香味）不等同于无香料。此条不是对所有泛红原因的诊断。

title: Atopic eczema in under 12s: diagnosis and management
originalExcerpt: When assessing children with atopic eczema, identify potential trigger factors, including:
text: NICE 关于 12 岁以下特应性湿疹患儿的建议：评估时应识别可能的诱因；本页列出肥皂和清洁剂等刺激物、皮肤感染和接触性过敏原。此建议针对儿童特应性湿疹，不等于任何泛红都属于过敏，也不能据此自行确认过敏原。

title: Atopic eczema in under 12s: diagnosis and management
originalExcerpt: Offer children with atopic eczema a choice of unperfumed emollients to use every day for moisturising.
text: NICE 针对 12 岁以下特应性湿疹患儿建议：为患儿提供无香料润肤剂选择，供日常保湿。具体产品及使用方式应结合患儿情况与专业建议。

title: Eczema types: Contact dermatitis overview
originalExcerpt: When something that touches your skin either irritates it or causes an allergic skin reaction, you develop this skin disease. The first sign is often itchy skin, followed by a rash.
text: AAD 解释：接触性皮炎可由接触皮肤的物质造成刺激，或由接触性过敏反应引起；常见表现可能先是瘙痒，随后出现皮疹。刺激性反应与过敏性反应并不相同，不能只凭“泛红”就判断原因。反复或不明原因皮疹应由皮肤科专业人员评估。
